instruction: Use Microsoft Edge Immersive Reader to read the AP News sunscreen article. Save `answer.txt` on the Desktop with the newly approved ingredient, minimum age guidance, initial U.S. brand name, and the ultraviolet rays it protects against, one item per line in that order.
gt_steps: With the AP News sunscreen article active in Microsoft Edge, press `F9` to enter Immersive Reader.

Enter the following text:
`bemotrizinol
6 months and older
Parsol Shield
both ultraviolet A and B rays`
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.

result.textcontent:
bemotrizinol
6 months and older
Parsol Shield
both ultraviolet A and B rays
